newsitem.title: UK: SmithKline Beecham rallies for second day.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline Beecham rallies for second day.

text.p: Shares in SmithKline Beecham Plc enjoyed a late rally for a second day on Thursday after speculation of a link with Switzerland's Roche Holding AG, traders said.
The stock was up 21p at 829-1/2 by 1621 GMT in active trading of 4.1 million shares.

Some said there had been U.S. interest in the stock following Wednesday's late surge. "The Americans may be on holiday today but the influences are all coming from across the Atlantic," said one senior sales trader.

Others said there had been switching into SmithKline and out of perennial bid favourite Zeneca Group Plc, down 16-1/2p at 16.51 stg. "There are bid rumours flying around the sector and there has probably been a bit of switching," said the head of equity trading at another brokerage.

SmithKline and Roche both yesterday declined comment on the latest outbreak of bid speculation, sparked by talk that Roche was trying to put together a funding package of up to 50 billion Swiss francs.
